name: Leon "leonjza" Jacobs
biography: With over two decades in IT - 15 years focused on cybersecurity - Leon is the CTO of Orange Cyberdefense’s SensePost Team. His career has taken him from a Tier 1 ISP, a private investment bank and now into full-time consulting, giving him a broad, real-world view of security challenges across industries. Today, Leon spends his time researching and hacking everything from enterprise networks to web and mobile applications. Passionate about building and innovating, he’s a regular contributor to the InfoSec community, sharing tools, insights, and lessons learned to help push the field forward.
